tools.name: mytool_search
tools.description: Search the index for packages whose name or keywords match a query. Use when you do not yet know the exact reference. Use mytool_describe instead when you already have one reference. Returns at most 50 rows with total and truncated fields; set limit or cursor to read more. Read only.

query.description: Text to match against names and keywords.

tools.name: mytool_describe
tools.description: Show the full record of one package. Use when you have an exact reference. Use mytool_search instead to find a reference. Returns the record as JSON.

ref.description: Exact package reference, such as registry/name:tag.

tools.name: mytool_status
tools.description: Report whether the local install matches the lock. Use before an update. Needs no arguments. Writes are enabled only when the server starts with --allow-writes.
